sloka: जातिरेव मम त्वेषा वानरो ऽहमिहागतः ।दर्शने राक्षसेन्द्रस्य दुर्लभे तदिदं मया ।। ५.५०.१४।।।।
transliteration: jātireva mama tveṣā vānaro 'hamihāgataḥ ।darśane rākṣasendrasya durlabhe tadidaṁ mayā ।। 5.50.14।।।।

translations.english: An audience with the lord of demons being hard to obtain, I destroyed this garden of the demon king in order to gain a sight of him.
